categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: System Management (SM), System Integration (SI), and Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging. SM involves managing and operating enterprise IT systems, SI focuses on planning, designing, and building IT systems including new ventures like metaverse platforms, and EV Charging includes manufacturing and operating electric vehicle chargers and related platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include IT system integration, cloud computing, AI, big data analytics, blockchain, and autonomous driving systems. The EV charging segment manufactures a full lineup of chargers from slow to ultra-fast, leveraging advanced hardware and firmware design. The company also operates data centers with green IT technologies and develops metaverse platforms using blockchain and NFT technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly large corporate clients within the Lotte Group such as Lotte Shopping, Hotel Lotte, and Lotte Wellfood, accounting for about 24% of total sales. The company serves diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, logistics, construction, transportation, and healthcare, with expanding markets in digital transformation, metaverse, and EV charging infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea with major facilities in Seoul, Daejeon, and Yongin. The company also has subsidiaries and business activities in Vietnam and Indonesia, with ongoing considerations for overseas expansion in the EV charging market.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT and EV charging supply chains. It provides system integration and management services (midstream) and manufactures EV chargers while also operating charging platforms (downstream). It acts as a service provider and equipment manufacturer rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include digital transformation, AI, big data, blockchain, metaverse, autonomous driving, and EV charging technologies. R&D efforts focus on developing cloud-based platforms, blockchain services, AI-powered analytics, smart mobility solutions, and advanced EV charging systems. The company actively invests in new growth areas like metaverse platforms and mobility-related services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based system integration contracts, ongoing system management service fees, and sales of EV charging equipment. The company also earns from operating EV charging platforms and related services. Most sales are customized solutions tailored to client needs, with revenue recognized from direct sales and service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading IT service provider within the Lotte Group ecosystem and the broader Korean market, competing with other large IT service firms and EV charger manufacturers like SK Signet. Its competitive advantages include strong group synergies, comprehensive IT and EV charging capabilities, and a growing presence in emerging sectors like metaverse and autonomous mobility.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 1.2 trillion (about USD 1 billion) with a 14.2% year-over-year growth and operating profit of KRW 56.9 billion, a 66.3% increase. Total assets stood at KRW 944 billion with a stable capital structure. The company has shown consistent growth driven by large project wins and expansion in EV charging and new business areas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its ability to deliver customized, integrated IT solutions that enhance client business competitiveness and operational efficiency. Its full lineup EV charging manufacturing capability and proprietary charging platform provide a competitive edge in the growing EV market. Additionally, its leadership in digital transformation technologies, including AI, blockchain, and metaverse, differentiates it as a forward-looking innovator.
